body.message:
Your explanation does not match the condition of the apartment when I arrived.

I have clear photos and videos showing that the apartment was still being cleaned and was not ready for guests at the agreed check-in time. This was not simply an AC issue.

The apartment was clearly not in a condition suitable for check-in, and I will use this evidence if I need to escalate the matter to Booking.com and the relevant authorities.

I am requesting a full refund immediately.
